gloss: to stand still; to remain motionless

definitions.gloss: to stand still; to remain motionless; to be stationary
definitions.explanation: To stop all movement and remain perfectly still. Used for people, objects, or abstract things like images.

examples.english: He stood still on the spot.

examples.japanese: ⟦{時間|じかん}→時間：00468_jikan⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{静止|せいし}した⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧⟦のように→のように：30291_noyouni⟧⟦{感|かん}じた→感じる：02044_kanjiru⟧。
examples.english: It felt as if time had stood still.

examples.japanese: ⟦{人工衛星|じんこうえいせい}→人工衛星：11715_jinkoueisei⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{地球|ちきゅう}→地球：03461_chikyuu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{上空|じょうくう}→上空：03080_joukuu⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{静止|せいし}して⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧よう⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{見|み}える→見える：01165_mieru⟧⟦{軌道|きどう}→軌道：06360_kidou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{静止軌道|せいしきどう}→静止軌道：29619_seishikidou⟧⟦という→という：09577_toiu⟧。
examples.english: An orbit where a satellite appears to remain stationary above the Earth is called a geostationary orbit.

notes:
Emphasizes complete absence of movement. Often used in scientific, technical, or literary contexts. The noun form ⟦{静止|せいし}→静止：15849_seishi⟧ is common in compound words.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{静止|せいし}→静止：15849_seishi⟧⟦{画像|がぞう}→画像：13549_gazou⟧: still image
- ⟦{静止|せいし}{軌道|きどう}→静止軌道：29619_seishikidou⟧: geostationary orbit
- ⟦{静止|せいし}→静止：15849_seishi⟧⟦{状態|じょうたい}→状態：03345_joutai⟧: stationary state
- ⟦{静止|せいし}{衛星|えいせい}→静止衛星：29862_seishieisei⟧: geostationary satellite
- ⟦ぴたり→ぴたり：22253_pitari⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{静止|せいし}する: to come to a dead stop

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{止|と}まる→止まる：00555_tomaru⟧: to stop — everyday word; can refer to stopping movement or functioning
- ⟦{停止|ていし}する→停止する：20992_teishisuru⟧: to halt; to cease operation — often for machines, systems, or deliberate stopping
- ⟦じっとする→じっとする：25342_jittosuru⟧: to stay still — colloquial; often used as a command to children or animals
